title: Auto-park a task stuck on an unanswered question (10 min), pick the next backlog task, resume on answer (REQ-0063)
requirement: REQ-0063 AC2-AC7; AC1 trial is done in TASK-098 verify. Builds on task_checkpoint.sh ask/due + tasks.sh hold/resume. New hook/guard block needs user confirmation. Trial (TASK-098, work/TASK-098/evidence/park-trial.txt, 20/22): fix F-98-PT1 workflow-check reports a held task as missing (_tasks.py:503-505) first; add held age to tasks.sh status (AC9d); list held tasks first for a returning user (AC9b); auto-park itself does not exist yet (hold manual, due only reports).

100.10 returning user sees held tasks first (AC9b, AC9d)

design.summary: Auto-hold on an unanswered user-only question: task_checkpoint.sh watch (background, 30 s poll) -> tasks.sh autohold (hold+commit+pick workable+commit) -> resume on answer; fixes F-98-PT1, F-100-D1/D2; held-first status/brief; no new block.
design.risks: F-100-D1 pick refused while a task is held (100.3); F-100-D2 commit refuses held task (100.2); D2 dialog vs watcher unproven (V10); paid detection only via explicit fields

implementation.summary: 100.1-100.10 code: held task passes workflow-check/commit/pick (F-98-PT1, F-100-D1/D2); ask --kind user-only; task_checkpoint.sh watch; tasks.sh autohold + workable; resume at safe point; rc 5 stop once; held-first status/brief. 100.11 skill docs. Settings brief hook = work/TASK-100/patches/settings-brief-hook.patch (classifier refused main; user to apply).
